ELECTRICITY — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

2. When learning Single Phase AC Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Circuits.

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Circuits.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards

   D. Skip safety briefings for DC Generators.

11. When learning Inspection and Testing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Inspection and Testing.

12. When learning Earthing and Excess Current Protection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Earthing and Excess Current Protection.

   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

15. When learning Electronics 4.4 Project Identification, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

16. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
